prompt: A photorealistic medium close-up, 16:9, of a masked man hijacking a TV signal, as if a frame from 1987 analogue broadcast video: slightly soft, the reds bleeding a little. He leans toward the lens, jabbing a gloved finger at the viewer while his other hand swirls a glass of red wine at chest height. His head is a hand-knitted oxblood rib balaclava, pilled and fuzzy, one continuous unbroken knitted surface over the whole face. A large cream-white felt ring is appliqued around the face with visible edge stitching; a small solid bright-red felt triangle with rounded corners sits inside it at two o'clock, on the right side of the image, following the curve of the head. A crumpled black suit jacket, white shirt collar buttoned up over the hood's neck. Black leather gloves, each with a thumbnail-sized stitched ring-and-triangle patch on the back. Behind him a dented sheet of corrugated metal, lit by one harsh bare lamp from frame left that throws a hard shadow. Framed off-centre. Thanks.
